description: This file contains initialization code for the i.MX8MQ6 SoC, including RDC and clock setup functions, and a system initialization routine.

methods.name: SOC_RdcInit
methods.description: Initializes RDC domain assignment and enables clocks for the M4 core.

methods.name: SOC_ClockInit
methods.description: Configures system clocks and enables necessary clocks for peripherals and core operation.

methods.name: nxp_mimx8mq6_init
methods.description: Main initialization function called at system startup to set up RDC and clocks.
